title: Information or architecture? A decomposition protocol for evaluating deep learning gains in volatility forecasting
description: Replication material for a paper that decomposes the out-of-sample gain of deep learning in volatility forecasting into the value of high-frequency information, the value of exogenous forward-looking information, and the value of the nonlinear architecture, holding the information set fixed between the deep learning model and its linear counterpart.
